target_name: Cheap Self-Funded Builders of Brand and Knowledge
rationale: This is a mechanical stack of two already-tested conditioners (gen-1 brand-and-knowledge share, gen-2 net cash) on the unchanged hard-book anchor, with no new mechanism and an undiscussed nested-SUMRANK weighting (50% value, 25% each conditioner) that makes any incremental result uninterpretable relative to its two parents.

target_name: Cheap Knowledge Firms with Unlevered Balance Sheets
rationale: Swapping net cash for pure leverage is only a leg substitution, but it is a genuinely diagnostic decomposition of the gen-2 funding-capacity result and is economically motivated (non-collateralizable knowledge capital plus offsetting the value leg's distress loading), so it is worth one test.

Another two-conditioner stack, but the horizon (R&D/revenue) and survivability (net cash) legs are conceptually orthogonal rather than two intensity proxies, so the joint test carries some information beyond its parents — though it should be judged only against the 5.6% and 7.3% parent alphas, not against zero.

target_name: Cheap Firms Shrinking Their Acquired Intangibles
rationale: NEG(ΔGoodwill/at) is close to a goodwill-restricted asset-growth/acquirer-underperformance signal already partly spanned by CMA and by the archive's gen-1 goodwill-change signal, its expected positive sign sits awkwardly against published post-impairment underperformance, and the huge mass point at Δgdwl = 0 (all non-acquirers) makes the conditioner rank largely degenerate so the composite will be driven by the value leg.

target_name: Knowledge Intensity Versus Premium Over Hard Book
rationale: The stated motivation is internally inconsistent — replacing enterprise value with market cap *introduces* rather than removes leverage contamination (levered firms mechanically get a low ME/at and hence a high signal) — and what remains is essentially R&D intensity plus a book-to-market proxy, i.e. a scaling variant of the gen-0 signal and of the well-known R&D-adjusted value effect.

target_name: Smoothed Cheapness with Organic Knowledge Share
rationale: A three-year moving average of the incumbent's value leg is a cosmetic timing variant, not a substantive mechanism change, and with annual accounting data it mostly injects stale prices (mixing in 2-3 year-old momentum/reversal information) rather than cleanly separating persistent undervaluation from a recent price collapse.
